1879073712.name: Crack The Whip
1879073712.desc: Your blistering derision shames your target to higher health.

1879102640.name: Force Opening
1879102640.desc: An attack that will force open a parry response.

procEffects.description: DNT - Whenever you are hit by an attack, your Block/parry Ratings will increase by X.
DNT - Your attacks will deal additional damage based on the number of bleeds on your target.
DNT - Whenever you block an attack, you will gain a small amount of critical defence.
Up to once per second, when you Block or Partially Block:

1879110960.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Sabre-tooth)
1879110960.desc: Summons a sabre-tooth cat companion.\n\nThe sabre-tooth cat hails from the north and can wield the cold of its home.

1879139376.name: Blade Fury
1879139376.desc: A full area-of-effect attack striking all around you.

1879215024.name: Good Map to Tírith Rhaw
1879215024.desc: A well drawn and detailed map to Tírith Rhaw.

1879225776.name: Scribe Manual: Pibgorn
1879225776.desc: This will scribe a manual to teach others to play the Pibgorn. Doing so is much more taxing than training in person and requires a Blank Mentor Manual.

1879241648.name: Call of the Eorlingas - Free
1879241648.desc: Your Call greatly heartens a rider and their war-steed.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This skill will drain no power when executed.</rgb>

1879243696.name: Piercing Claws
1879243696.desc: Your vicious claws allow you to tear through even the toughest armour.  This skill is only effective against players.\n\n   <rgb=#00FFDD>Bypasses Mitigations</rgb>

1879243824.name: Horn of Champions
1879243824.desc: Blow a clear note, damaging many enemies around you.\n\nFor the Martial Champion, this increases your threat over time.

1879244848.name: Clash of Steel and Will
1879244848.desc: This quick strike saps your target's morale and has a chance on a critical strike to restore power to you and your war-steed.

1879269680.name: Sneaky Trick: Disable
1879269680.desc: Strike to slow the attacks of foes in a large area.\n\nLimit: One Trick per target.

1879288368.name: Celebration of Skill
1879288368.desc: An impressive movement that restores a significant amount of morale.

conditionalEffects.description: Shield Gambits each restore 2.5% of your max health and reduce the cooldown of Desperate Combat by 2 seconds.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879297072.name: Fulgurite Rune-stone
1879297072.desc: Places a Rune-stone upon the ground which, after a few seconds, is struck by lightning, damaging and briefly stunning nearby foes. This skill can be placed at range.

1879305392.name: Meriadoc's Rock
1879305392.desc: Merry can do his part by throwing stones at an enemy.

1879313840.name: Steed of Wedmath Celebration
1879313840.desc: A horse from the Summer Festival.

1879343920.name: Midsummer's Comet Kite
1879343920.desc: Brings out a midsummer's comet kite for you to fly in the wind.

1879346352.name: Glory of the First Age
1879346352.desc: You may periodically immobilize a foe.

1879381552.name: Harbinger of Autumn Night
1879381552.desc: A horse from the Fall Festival.

1879386032.name: Brown Pig
1879386032.desc: Brings out a brown pig to keep you company.

1879403696.name: Drop Phial of Eärendil's Light
1879403696.desc: Discard the Phial of Eärendil's Light and set it on the ground.

1879412016.name: Boar of the Three Peaks
1879412016.desc: This boar appears to be a hardy War of Three Peaks veteran.

1879414192.name: Warm Winter Goat Kid
1879414192.desc: This little goat is well prepared for winter adventures.

1879420848.name: Copper Nether-hound
1879420848.desc: Summons a nether-hound to help you search caverns and other tight spaces.

1879442096.name: Yule Princess Bunny
1879442096.desc: A regal bunny wearing a crown of holly will deign to keep you company.

1879457072.name: Rakish Feline
1879457072.desc: Summons a stylish fluffy cat to accompany you on your journeys.

1879469744.name: Steady Traveller
1879469744.desc: A life of travel allows you to quickly steady yourself, regardless of your current circumstances.

1879491504.name: Return to Urmâkh
1879491504.desc: You're able to quickly return to Urmâkh in Imhûlar in the Ikorbân Valley. This skill is easily interrupted.
